text:
alex.partnerships: Quick sync thread for DeltaMesh (Snowflake DeltaShare -> vector DB adapters) marketplace coordination. Proposed launch Wed Jul 14 09:00 PT. Calling owners for each lane below; reply with :white_check_mark: when you own it.

alex.partnerships: Checklist: 1) integration perf & compatibility (eng) 2) marketplace tile + screenshots (gtm) 3) docs + quickstarts (docs) 4) partner legal approvals (legal) 5) staging demo + runbook (infra)

rui.engineering: I'll take perf/compat. Running a 30M sample ingest on staging with int8 quant. Will validate nested VARIANT edge case and cross-account DeltaShare role flow. Posting ingest command and expected artifact path when started.

mira.docs: I'll own docs + quickstarts. Please drop the CLI snippet and a short Databricks notebook cell I can paste. Also want the decision matrix: live serve vs batch export.

sam.gtm: Marketplace copy + screenshots are on me. Need perf dashboard + console onboarding screenshots by Tue EOD to hit Wed launch. Also coordinating partner co-marketing ask.

olga.legal: Legal needs partner logo approvals + embargo agreement by Tue 16:00 PT. No partner quotes without signed release. Send logos as SVG + brand use notes.

infra-bot: Staging environment created: staging-deltamesh-2026-07-07 (owner: rui.engineering). Access granted to partner-team.

rui.engineering: Ingest command I'll use:
```
redwood ingest --connector deltamesh-snow-delta 
  --source delta://acct/db/schema/table 
  --sink vectordb://staging-vector:8000 
  --shards 6 
  --quantize int8 
  --output s3://redwood-artifacts/deltamesh-30m-2026-07-07.tar.gz
```
I'll attach p95 numbers and logs here. Found one mapping quirk with nested arrays; adding a normalize step to the connector. Patch will be small, targeting Mon morning.

mira.docs: For quickstart snippet draft (feel free to tweak):
```
# create DeltaMesh connector and run a one-off ingest
redwood connector create --type deltamesh --name dm-prod \
  --source delta://acct/db/schema/table \
  --sink vectordb://prod-vector:8000 \
  --options quantize=int8,batch_size=2000
redwood connector run --name dm-prod --once
```
Can someone confirm the recommended batch_size for 512-dim vectors?

rui.engineering: Recommend 2000 on p3-type instances; will add guidance to docs after perf finish.

sam.gtm: Filing marketplace tile copy suggestion: "DeltaMesh: serve vectors directly from Snowflake Delta tables or export to your vector DB of choice. Fast setup, predictable performance." Shorter headline variant: "DeltaMesh for Snowflake 1 serve or export vectors." Thoughts?

olga.legal: Please hold on the partner line until logos are cleared. Also confirm whether we reference Milvus, Qdrant, or a generic 'vector DBs' in the tile; partners may request specific naming rules.

rui.engineering: Perf snapshot: ingest 30M vectors, 6 shards, int8 -> ingest throughput ~24k vec/s, p95 ingest 400ms, query p95 ~30ms (512-dim). Artifacts uploaded to s3. Patch for normalize step opened: PR #3421.

mira.docs: Great, grabbing the dashboard screenshot. Adding two runbooks: "Live serving via DeltaShare" and "Batch export to vector DB" with decision flow. Will link PR docs to this thread.

sam.gtm: Screenshots captured. I'll send rough tile draft to design and drop assets once legal clears logos.

olga.legal: Reviewing assets now. Expect sign-off by Tue 15:30 PT unless partners request changes.

alex.partnerships: Recap + owners: rui.engineering (perf + PR) :white_check_mark:, mira.docs (docs + quickstart) :white_check_mark:, sam.gtm (marketplace + screenshots) :white_check_mark:, olga.legal (logo/embargo) pending.

alex.partnerships: If legal clears by Tue 16:00 PT, we'll lock Wed Jul 14 09:00 PT and send partner invites Tue 18:00 PT. If anything slips, we shift to Thu. Keeping this thread as canonical.

infra-bot: Demo runbook created and attached to staging: /runbooks/deltamesh-staging-2026-07-07.md

rui.engineering: One small note - Databricks sample needs an init script to install redwood-client. I'll add that cell to the notebook.

mira.docs: Added Databricks cluster-init snippet to the notebook draft. Linking gist when ready.

sam.gtm: All assets ready, waiting for legal.

olga.legal: Logos cleared with brand notes. No other IP issues. Sending embargo memo to partners now.

alex.partnerships: Launch locked Wed Jul 14 09:00 PT. Thanks team :tada:
